name: cast_vote
description: Casts your vote on the team's work during a discussion round with active voting. ALWAYS use this instead of (or in addition to) the text marker 'VOTE: ...': it's the reliable way to make your vote count.

vote.description: APPROVE if the work is satisfactory; REVISE if changes are needed (specify them in reason); REJECT if the work is wrong and must be redone.
